title: DEXF
content:
Overview

Overview of the development process used in DEXF project.

81995418901820248590dexf_devops_process.drawio111https://i-p-e-x.atlassian.net/wikidexf_devops_process.drawio791331

  • A team member picks a story and start implementation.
  • Once the implementation is done the team member creates a pull request.
  • The pull request gets reviewed and approved by at least one other team member.
  • Team member merges the change and starts a new build.
  • As part of the build process automatic tests are run
  • If all tests pass the maven artifact is stored in S3 and Docker images in docker repository (ECR)
  • Team member triggers a deploy to Dev environment.
  • Deployment to production is triggered manually.
    • Defects are deployed ASAP
    • Features are deployed one week after review meeting.
    • Blue / Green deployment, new version is tested before cutover.

Environments

DEXF uses three environment Dev, QA, and Prod. Each environment is run in a separate AWS account, creating separation. Build pipeline is run in the Dev account.

Separate accounts for Pingdom. Separate context / CP codes for Akamai, AWOT Self Service.

Swaggerhub only exists for a Prod environment.

Environment automation

CloudFormation and Sceptre is used for environment automation.

Some manual tasks still remain: Create new database schema and users, Cognito UserPool.

Security tasks

  • Periodically do penetration test, performed by external company.
  • OWASP Maven Dependency check

Verification

Automatic tests

  • Unit tests - Performed as part of the build pipeline.
  • Contract tests - Performed as part of the build pipeline.

Manual tests

  • Manual tests are run against dev environment.

Security tests

  • Security / Penetration tests - Contracted to be done by external party with each business release.


Tools

Generic

  • Git / Bitbucket - Source control.
  • Jira - Issue / task tracker.
  • Confluence - Documentation
  • AWS CodeBuild - Build pipeline

Test and monitoring

  • JUnit - Unit test framework
  • RestAssured - Contract / Api testing.
  • Mockito - Mocking framework
  • Prometheus - Monitoring service.
  • Grafana - Monitor and metrics visualisation.
  • Pingdom - Uptime check, alerts, etc
